description: This PHP source file defines an API class 'CandidateMarkingInterviewPassAPI' within the OrangeHRM recruitment module. It extends an abstract candidate action API and provides functionality to validate and process marking a candidate's interview as passed. The class includes a method for validation rules and the API endpoint's OpenAPI annotations for marking an interview as passed, including path parameters and expected responses.

classes.name: CandidateMarkingInterviewPassAPI
classes.description: API class for marking a candidate's interview as passed in the recruitment process, with validation and API endpoint configuration.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for updating the interview pass status, adding validation for 'interviewId'.

methods.name: getResultingState
methods.description: Returns the workflow state constant indicating the interview has been passed.
